caption:
Nobody calls a price they can't see.

They don't haggle over it. They don't message to ask. They just close the tab and call the next shop that gave them a number.

The fix takes one afternoon.

1. Pick your most requested service.
2. Set an honest floor: "Roof replacements start at..."
3. Post it in three places: your service page headline, your Google Business Profile products section, and the first line of your ad landing page.

A posted range doesn't cost you the job. It costs you the calls you never wanted in the first place.

Want a funnel built so every lead that reaches you is already qualified?
